title: Setup → Email shows provider SMTP with an empty host while mail goes to the development log sink and "Invitation sent" toasts appear — say on the page which transport is live (hotcrm#2194 T2-U12)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 邮件设置页显示 SMTP、主机为空，而平台邮件实际进了开发日志、状态记为「已发送」，邀请提示「已发送」但什么都发不出去。
- **要做：** 页面上说明当前生效的传输方式，例如「开发日志——邮件不会离开本机」。
- **完成标准：** 管理员在邮件设置页能看出邮件会不会真的发出。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U12**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Email, the system administrator.
- **Now:** provider "SMTP" with an empty host, while platform mails are stored with status "sent" (the dev mail sink).
- **Cost:** "Invitation sent" toasts while nothing could be delivered.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-12; [`27-config-email.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/27-config-email.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

Read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`:
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` ~:346–368: `IEmailService.isConfigured?()` now exists, shaped like `ISmsService.isConfigured()` (added under #25065, closed), and `plugin-email` answers `false` for its `log` transport.
- So the fact exists; this card is its reader on the Setup → Email page (the mail settings in `plugin-email` / `service-settings`, rendered by the console).

## Done when

- Setup → Email states which transport is live; with the log transport it says nothing leaves this machine.
- The statement follows a transport swap made from the same page.
- A pin on the page's reading of `isConfigured()`.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `transport`, `log sink`, `email`, `mail`. 27 hits on the broad words; the related ones are closed: #25065 (the contract fact this card reads) and #24767 (send-test recipients). The open ones (#25293, #25190, #25189, #24465) are other email subjects. **New.**
